subject.title: Feature Request: Inline media display in chat (images, audio, video, web previews)

question: Should Control UI support remote and rich inline media previews, and if so through direct browser fetches, a same-origin/proxy path, or a default-off permission surface?
rationale: Current code, tests, docs, and prior merged hardening intentionally prevent arbitrary remote media fetches, while the request asks for a broader UX feature that changes that boundary.

options.title: Keep no-remote-fetch default
options.body: Preserve the current default and approve only same-origin, local ticketed, data, or blob media until a proxy or opt-in design is specified.

options.title: Approve opt-in remote previews
options.body: Allow remote image or web previews only behind an explicit user/operator consent path with renderer, CSP, docs, tests, and browser proof changed together.

options.title: Split by focused issues
options.body: Keep this as an umbrella and make final decisions in the focused remote image, audio autoplay, and web preview issues before implementation.

recommendation.title: Keep no-remote-fetch default
recommendation.body: Preserve the current default and approve only same-origin, local ticketed, data, or blob media until a proxy or opt-in design is specified.

likelyOwner.reason: The central unresolved choice is the Control UI remote media/CSP security boundary most directly tied to drobison00's merged history.
